Sauce & Condiment

Capers

About This Entry

Capers is a canonical brined caper bud condiment for piccata and Mediterranean sauces ingredient in global cookery — its acidity, richness, and pairing behavior pair with structured whites, aromatic rosés, and spice-friendly reds when used as a finishing or table sauce.
